description: Hand-curated cross-check anchors for the adjustment function. Covers cash dividends, stock dividends, combined cash+stock dividends (the Taiwan large-cap convention, 除權息合一), and cash capital reductions (現金減資). Each event's raw close prices are fetched from TWSE's official STOCK_DAY endpoint; dividend amounts, stock-dividend ratios, and capital-reduction parameters are from primary sources (SEC 6-K for TSMC, AGM resolutions and TWSE MOPS announcements for Taiwan Cement, TWSE-filed corporate-action plan and corroborating news for Yageo). Sources deliberately independent of FinMind. The `expected_adj_close_ratio` field is the value the test asserts directly: X / (Y + D) for cash, X / (Y * (1 + R)) for stock, X / ((Y + D) * (1 + R)) for combined, (X - C) / (R * Y) for capital reduction. These are NOT the textbook back-adjustment factors (which are Y/(Y+D), 1/(1+R), their product, and (X-C)/(R*X) respectively). See journal/decisions/2026-05-18-corporate-actions-ingestion-overhaul.md.

Taiwan Cement Corp. (TSC) 2020 AGM resolution distributing FY2019 earnings: cash dividend NT$2.50 per share + stock dividend NT$0.50 per share at NT$10 face value (i.e. 50 new shares per 1,000 existing shares, ratio = 0.05). Cross-validated against the TWSE MOPS ex-rights/ex-dividend announcement at https://mops.twse.com.tw/mops/web/t05st09_2 (1101, ex-date 2020/08/12) and TSC corporate IR.

Taiwan Cement Corp. (TSC) 2022 AGM resolution distributing FY2021 earnings: cash dividend NT$1.00 per share + stock dividend NT$1.00 per share at NT$10 face value (i.e. 100 new shares per 1,000 existing shares, ratio = 0.10). Cross-validated against the TWSE MOPS ex-rights/ex-dividend announcement at https://mops.twse.com.tw/mops/web/t05st09_2 (1101, ex-date 2022/07/21) and TSC corporate IR. Picked as the second 1101 anchor for ratio diversity (0.05 vs 0.10) and to give the cross-check two independent combined-event data points.

Yageo Corp (2327) cash capital reduction (現金減資). Board resolution 2022-03-17, AGM-approved June 2022. Per Yageo's TWSE-filed corporate-action plan: 108,011,200 shares eliminated from a pre-event outstanding base of 529,272,005 shares (= 544,060,005 issued less 14,788,000 treasury shares awaiting cancellation), giving exact elimination ratio 108,011,200 / 529,272,005 = 0.20407502943, R = 0.79592497057 (i.e. 795.92497057 new shares per 1,000 old shares), and cash refund NT$2.0407502943 per OLD share (= NT$10 par × elimination ratio). Trading suspended 2022-10-20 to 2022-10-28; reduction record date 2022-10-28; new shares first traded 2022-10-31 at TWSE-set ex-reduction reference price NT$334.15. Cross-validated against THREE documents that do not share the FinMind pipeline: (1) Yageo's MOPS-filed cash-reduction operational plan (主旨: 公告本公司董事會訂定換股作業計劃及減資換發股票基準日等相關事宜), announcement 序號 1 dated 民國111年09月13日 17:06:49 at https://mops.twse.com.tw/mops/web/t05st09_2 — directly states 529,272,005 outstanding shares, 108,011,200 shares eliminated, NT$2.0407502943 cash refund per old share, basis date 2022-10-28, new shares first traded 2022-10-31. Confirmed by Yageo's subsequent post-completion filing (主旨: 公告本公司辦理現金減資完成實收資本額變更登記) dated 2022-09-16 reporting final outstanding count 436,048,805 (= 421,260,805 + 14,788,000 treasury yet to be cancelled). Cross-validated against (2) Liberty Times Net news report at https://ec.ltn.com.tw/article/breakingnews/4056976 (2022-09-13) and (3) UDN report on TWSE's published ex-reduction reference price NT$334.15 at https://money.udn.com/money/story/5607/6727376 (2022-10-31). All sources agree precisely on share counts, refund per share, and TWSE-set reference price. Picked because: (a) clean single-action ex-date — no concurrent dividend or stock split, (b) modest representative ratio (~20% reduction) — avoiding extreme cases, (c) cash-refund event rather than pure loss-coverage, so the anchor exercises BOTH the R (share-count) and C (cash-per-share) branches of the capital_reduction formula in a single event.
